locations.description: _The fields of Inkville, where villagers work from dawn to dusk, living simply and in harmony, harvesting the land's gifts._

locations.title: Loong Pagoda
locations.description: _A towering shrine dedicated to the Loong rises proudly, said to have stood here since Inkville's founding. Over time, its structure has become tightly wrapped in layers of red ribbons._

locations.title: Loongwatch Pavilion
locations.description: _At the mountaintop stands a humble, ancient pavilion, its origins lost to time, built long ago by unknown hands. From there, it gazes across at Loong Peak._

locations.title: Back Mountain
locations.description: _The secluded back mountain, long abandoned and shrouded in dense forest, hides secrets unknown to all._

locations.title: Waterview Crossing
locations.description: _The wooden posts are all weathered and worn, the ropes heavy with moisture. No one passes by here on ordinary days, only the gentle flow of water murmurs toward an unknown shore._

locations.title: Inkville Market
locations.description: _The houses stand close, their eaves casting intertwined shadows. Neighborly chatter and laughter drift through the lanes, flowing endlessly like a gentle current._

locations.title: Mid-slope of Loong Peak
locations.description: _Layers of red leaves pile up along winding mountain paths. Villagers once caught distant glimpses of the Loong resting there._

locations.title: Side Peak of Loong Peak
locations.description: _The side peak of Loong Peak, linked to the main summit by a wooden bridge, is cloaked in swirling mist and notably treacherous._

locations.title: Loong Peak Summit
locations.description: _Climbing to the top, you take in a breathtaking panorama! Near and far unfolding before your eyes. This was once the resting place of the Loong._

locations.title: Wanderbloom Grove
locations.description: _A lush grove of flowers sways gently, its delicate beauty lingering like the flutter of a heart at the moment fate unfolds, a perfect place to forge lasting bonds._

locations.description:

_The bamboo grove is tranquil, and the stream flows gently when a suddenly a clear, crisp call drifts in on the wind. Is it a long-awaited reunion, or the beginning of a new Yin Yuan? The answer lies beyond the river, waiting to be found._

_The Eye-Dotting Ceremony failed, setting off an unusual phenomenon. Ms. Cui connected this to the strange events in the village and suspects that the Loong guarding Danqing Island may be in danger. To get to the bottom of it, it would be wise to visit Loong Pagoda with Miss Bai and investigate further._

**Rewards:**

- Thread of Purity x120
- Blings x15K
